🔴 Islamic State Sahel group kills 48 in Mali attack

Islamic State in Sahel Province (ISSP) attacked civilians in Ménaka region of eastern Mali Sunday night into Monday morning, killing 48 people including children and elderly, according to Moussa Ag Acharatoumane, a Tuareg leader and National Transitional Council member.
The group accused the civilians of revealing ISSP positions to the Malian army, which had conducted drone strikes against the militants. ISSP operates primarily in Ménaka, where it competes with rival militant group Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), and across Burkina Faso and Niger.

results.description:
More Than 40 Civilians Killed in Armed Attack on Camps in Northeastern Mali

⭕ An armed attack on camps in the Menaka region of northeastern Mali killed more than 40 civilians over the weekend, amid accusations that Islamic State was behind the assault.

⭕ Security and community sources said the attackers arrived on motorcycles and targeted camps largely inhabited by members of the Daoussahak community. The community’s executive office blamed the Islamic State group for the killings.

⭕ A security source based in Gao said the attack was retaliation for recent military operations in the area, as well as attacks by the South Asian Army, according to the source.
